text:
Where do my words go,

if you no longer hear me?

Where would they go when you heard me?

And when did you hear me?

Never. Lost, lost.

Ah, everything is lost!

You and I lost everything.

We begged for the infinite.

They gave us only the world.

On one side of the waters, on one side of death,

your thirst shone in the dark waters. And today,

what boat comes to your aid? What god embraces you?

With what god do you struggle? I, in the shadows.

I, through the shadows, with the same questions.

For what? For what?

Foolish turnings in fields of vast sands and abundant clouds.

translation.title: Fifth Motif of the Rose
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the grief-struck questions, the lost infinity, and the final circling through sand and cloud.
